name: Witherbark Cages
summary: At Witherbark Cages, you search for Sharpbeak, heir of Swiftwing, whom Talonaxe calls the mightiest gryphon. Gryphon Master Talonaxe believes the trolls took the young gryphon.

sections.title: A Missing Heir
sections.body: Gryphon Master Talonaxe asks you to find Sharpbeak, who went missing a few days ago while hunting with his parents. Talonaxe and the others believe the trolls took him. Three cages in the two Witherbark troll villages remain to be checked. Talonaxe awaits your findings.

sections.title: Word From the Villages
sections.body: Sharpbeak is not in the Witherbark villages. Talonaxe takes the news gravely. The young gryphon is meant to lead the next generation. Without him, the fleet would lose much of its strength and spirit.

faq.answer: Sharpbeak is Swiftwing's heir, and Talonaxe calls Swiftwing the mightiest gryphon. Sharpbeak went missing a few days ago while hunting with his parents.

faq.q: Why are the Witherbark trolls suspected?
faq.answer: Talonaxe and the others believe the Witherbark trolls took Sharpbeak. The cages in their two villages are the first places to search.

faq.q: Where do I search for Sharpbeak?
faq.answer: Search the cages in the two Witherbark troll villages. Then return to Gryphon Master Talonaxe and tell him what you found.
